mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy within 3 months, or if 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to increased corporate costs within 6 months, or if 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% MoM signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM > 5% does not correlate with increased economic activity within 1 month, or if 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in 3 months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS 3-month increase > 0.5% does not lead to tighter monetary policy within 3 months, or if 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 does not correlate with increased consumer spending within 1 month, or if 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% does not correlate with decreased economic activity within 2 months, or if 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 1% MoM signals a broad-based increase in economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS and HOUST MoM increases do not correlate with increased economic demand within 1 month, or if 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where the level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 12-month moving average predicts the direction of S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS relative to its 12-month moving average does not predict the direction of 60-day forward returns with a Rank IC above 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
